title: Solo Leveling Studio A-1 Pictures Reports 91 Million Yen Profit in Fiscal 2026 Following Previous Year's Loss
content: A-1 Pictures returned to profitability in the fiscal year ending March 2026, reporting a net profit of 91.649 million yen (~$564,000USD) after recording a net loss of about 178 million yen the previous year.
author: Anime Corner

title: Hunter x Hunter Manga Tops 100 Million Copies in Circulation
content: The manga resumed serialization on Monday. Shueisha will publish the manga's 39th compiled book volume (image right), its first volume in 22 months, on July 3. Shueisha published chapters 401 to 410 of the manga in its Weekly Shonen Jump magazine from issue 45 of 2024 to issue two of 2025.
author: ANN

title: Blade & Bastard Anime's Teaser Reveals Main Staff, 2027 Debut on HIDIVE
content: Warner Bros. Japan revealed the teaser promotional video, main staff, and 2027 debut for the television anime of writer Kumo Kagyu and illustrator so-bin 's Blade & Bastard light novel series on Tuesday.
author: ANN

title: Bananya Franchise Confirms New 10th Anniversary Anime Debuting on July 10
content: The staff for the Bananya television anime confirmed on Tuesday Bananya At Home Party , a new anime to celebrate the first Bananya anime's 10th anniversary. The staff also unveiled the new anime's main promotional video, key visual, cast and staff members, and July 10 premiere.
author: ANN

title: BLADE & BASTARD Trailer and Main Staff Revealed
content: BLADE & BASTARD anime revealed a new teaser trailer, along with the studio and main staff ahead of its 2027 release date. We previously had the exclusive announcement that HIDIVE will stream the anime next year.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Bugle Call Anime Announced for 2027, CyberAgent's New Studio's First Production
content: The Bugle Call: Song of War is officially receiving a TV anime adaptation, with the series scheduled to premiere in 2027. The announcement also marks the debut production of CA Soa , CyberAgent Group’s newly established animation studio.
author: Anime Corner

title: Exclusive: HIDIVE Acquires BLADE & BASTARD for 2027, Dark Fantasy Anime Adapting Novel by Goblin Slayer Author
content: AMC Global Media’s anime streaming service HIDIVE has announced that it will exclusively stream the upcoming dark fantasy anime BLADE & BASTARD as part of its 2027 simulcast lineup. The main staff was also revealed.
author: Anime Corner

title: Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 Japanese & English Voice Cast Revealed, Includes Koki Uchiyama as D, Akari Kito as Talia
content: CYBERPUNK EDGERUNNERS 2 voice cast was revealed following the trailer release yesterday, with Koki Uchiyama and Akari Kito among the Japanese members. Studio TRIGGER is back to animate, with the anime set to release on Netflix in Fall 2026.
author: Anime Corner

title: Manga 'Sensou Kyoushitsu' Gets TV Anime Adaptation for 2027
content: Production company CyberAgent opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Mozuku Sora and Higoro Toumori 's Sensou Kyoushitsu ( The Bugle Call: Song of War ) on Tuesday and revealed the main staff, a teaser visual (pictured), and a teaser promotional video.
author: MyAnimeList

title: The Bugle Call: Song of War Fantasy War Manga Gets TV Anime in 2027
content: CyberAgent announced on Tuesday that its CA Soa anime studio is producing a television anime adaptation of Mozuku Sora and Higoro Tōmori 's The Bugle Call: Song of War ( Sensō Kyōshitsu ) manga that will premiere in 2027. CyberAgent unveiled a teaser trailer and visual for the anime.
author: ANN
